Short version: all 10 hunks of the 7 build/CI files are attributed (53 added, 5 removed lines, counted with awk over the per-file diffs). 23 lines are L (the option, its two compile definitions) and 30 are B (registration, preset, CI flag, README, cost rows). Counts per file (added/removed): CMakeLists.txt 1/0 (L); src/tron/CMakeLists.txt 15/0 + 7/0 (L); t/CMakeLists.txt 1/0 (B); CMakePresets.json 2/1 (B); .github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml 2/1 (B); README.ci.md 2/1 + 20/0 (B); config/test-benchmarks.json 1/1 + 2/1 (B). Three of the removed lines are churn only (a trailing comma in CMakePresets.json, a trailing backslash in the workflow and in README.ci.md).

Things that surprised me or that the planner must know:

1. Two B lines are welded to L. The ctest registration (t/CMakeLists.txt) and the t_k_vnni_layout cost row (config/test-benchmarks.json hunk 2 part 2) must ship in the PR that creates t/t_k_vnni_layout.cpp. Reason 1: add_catch_test defaults FILES to ${TEST_NAME}.cpp, so CMake configure fails without the file [t/CMakeLists.txt:118-120]. Reason 2: the CI step 'Check slice cost data' runs bin/slice bench --check, which exits 1 when a registered test has no cost row on any platform [.github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml:359-362, bin/slice:1972-1978].

2. The 'flag ON' lines of B (workflow flag, README hunk 1, README paragraph, deb preset) presume every reader of the layout exists. page::k() does not exist for VNNI slots [kv_cache.hpp diff, Note [K VNNI storage] item 6], so with TRON_K_VNNI=ON the software loop needs R, the dense AMX page needs A (CI and deb both set TRON_AMX_DISPATCH=ON), and the FPGA staging needs G (the CMake lane builds the fpga-labelled GOF tests). They do not need S or T. So the earliest PR for those lines is the one after the last of R, A, G. Until then the L PR ships the option default OFF, and the kv_cache integration cases of t_k_vnni_layout (#ifdef TRON_K_VNNI at t/t_k_vnni_layout.cpp:559, 674, 729, 802, 821) and the VNNI branches of t_llama_unit are compiled out in CI.

3. The deb preset line and the README deb sentence (lines 3-7 of README hunk 2) are the newest commit 0a5334ccb6 (2026-10-09) and equal ref B-preset.diff exactly. They can be the last PR of the stack on their own.

4. README hunk 2 names tests of S ('the save_k case of t_llama_unit') and A ('the VNNI kernel case of t_amx_numerics', 'The kernel case executes AMX only on a Granite Rapids runner'). If the paragraph lands before S or A, those clauses must be dropped and restored later. I kept every README line as B per the code list and recorded the cross-references per line range instead of relabelling prose lines.

5. src/tron/CMakeLists.txt hunk 1 (L) has two comment lines that justify the FATAL_ERROR gate by the AMX QK kernel, which is A code. The gate itself is harmless in an L-only PR; only the wording presumes A. Hunk 2 (the tron_model_compile_config definition, c6ec38813d, 2026-10-02) came into the head through the typed-port seam [ref P diff lines 1256-1271]; it has no dependency outside L and must stay with hunk 1.

6. The cost rows are measured values of the full head (6b939d25d2, granite_rapids_6962p). They cannot be derived for an intermediate PR stage: the t_amx_numerics 1-job time went down (0.903 s -> 0.81 s) although A added a case, so the deltas are noise. Each PR that adds cases to t_llama_unit, t_amx_numerics or t_k_vnni_layout needs its own bin/slice bench --update run on a 6962p host.
